mapper.select: select campus_id id, null parent_id, campus_name name, null open_time, null close_time from seatflow_campus where status = 'enabled' order by campus_id
select building_id id, campus_id parent_id, building_name name, null open_time, null close_time from seatflow_building where status = 'enabled' and campus_id = #{campusId} order by building_id

select floor_id id, building_id parent_id, floor_name name, null open_time, null close_time from seatflow_floor where status = 'enabled' and building_id = #{buildingId} order by floor_number, floor_id

select room_id id, floor_id parent_id, room_name name, time_format(open_time, '%H:%i:%s') open_time, time_format(close_time, '%H:%i:%s') close_time from seatflow_room where status = 'enabled' and floor_id = #{floorId} order by room_id

select s.seat_id, s.room_id, s.seat_no, s.row_num, s.col_num, case when s.status = 'disabled' then 'disabled' when exists (select 1 from seatflow_reservation r where r.seat_id = s.seat_id and r.status = 'in_use' and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{startTime}) then 'in_use' when exists (select 1 from seatflow_reservation r where r.seat_id = s.seat_id and r.status = 'pending_checkin' and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{startTime}) then 'reserved' else 'available' end display_status from seatflow_seat s where s.room_id = #{roomId} order by s.row_num, s.col_num

select s.seat_id, s.room_id, s.status seat_status, rm.status room_status, time_format(rm.open_time, '%H:%i:%s') open_time, time_format(rm.close_time, '%H:%i:%s') close_time from seatflow_seat s inner join seatflow_room rm on rm.room_id = s.room_id where s.seat_id = #{seatId} for update
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} for update

select case when exists(select 1 from seatflow_user_profile p where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.blacklist_flag = 'yes') or exists(select 1 from seatflow_blacklist b where b.user_id = #{userId} and b.status = 'active' and (b.end_time is null or b.end_time > now())) then 1 else 0 end
select count(*) from seatflow_reservation where user_id = #{userId} and date(start_time) = date(#{startTime}) and status != 'cancelled'
select count(*) from seatflow_reservation where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('pending_checkin','in_use') and start_time < #{endTime} and end_time > #{startTime}
select count(*) from seatflow_reservation where seat_id = #{seatId} and status in ('pending_checkin','in_use') and start_time < #{endTime} and end_time > #{startTime}
mapper.insert: insert into seatflow_reservation(user_id, room_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, check_deadline, status, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{request.roomId}, #{request.seatId}, #{request.startTime}, #{request.endTime}, #{checkDeadline}, 'pending_checkin', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select r.reservation_id, r.room_id, rm.room_name, r.seat_id, s.seat_no, cp.campus_name, bd.building_name, fl.floor_name, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.check_deadline, r.status, r.cancel_time, r.create_time from seatflow_reservation r inner join seatflow_seat s on s.seat_id = r.seat_id inner join seatflow_room rm on rm.room_id = r.room_id inner join seatflow_floor fl on fl.floor_id = rm.floor_id inner join seatflow_building bd on bd.building_id = fl.building_id inner join seatflow_campus cp on cp.campus_id = bd.campus_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = #{status} order by r.start_time desc, r.reservation_id desc

select reservation_id, room_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, check_deadline, status, cancel_time, create_time from seatflow_reservation where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and user_id = #{userId} for update
